name: Zotepine
summary: Zotepine is a newer (atypical) antipsychotic used for schizophrenia, especially when there are negative symptoms, and in some mood disorders; it is not widely available and is used mainly in parts of Europe and Asia.
description: Zotepine is a newer (second-generation, atypical) antipsychotic. It blocks dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2 receptors and also raises noradrenaline (by blocking its reabsorption). It is used to treat schizophrenia, especially when there are negative symptoms (such as low motivation and withdrawal), and in some mood disorders. It is not widely available, and it is used more in parts of Europe and Asia. It can cause notable sleepiness and weight gain, so careful checks of weight, blood sugar and cholesterol are recommended.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Zotepine is a second-generation (atypical) antipsychotic with dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2 receptor antagonism, and additional noradrenaline reuptake inhibition. It is used in the management of schizophrenia, particularly in cases with negative symptoms, and in some mood disorders. Zotepine is not widely available in all countries, and its use is more common in parts of Europe and Asia. Sedative and weight gain effects are notable, and careful metabolic monitoring is recommended.
